newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine state agency taps ABN-AMRO as advisor.
newsitem.headline: Philippine state agency taps ABN-AMRO as advisor.

text.p: The Philippines' Bases Conversion Development Authority (Basecon) said on Wednesday it had chosen a group of international financial institutions led by ABN-AMRO Bank as its global financial advisor.
The group will assist Basecon and its subsidiaries in their financial planning, financial restructuring, fund raising, project evaluation and other finance-related tasks, a Basecon statement said.
The group will also arrange the financing of immediate and long-term requirements of Basecon.
The group includes Peregrine Capital Philippines Inc, Corporate Access Holdings and McKinsey & Co Inc.
Seven groups were shortlisted by Basecon before it made the final selection. Twenty-eight companies had expressed an interest in becoming Basecon's financial advisor.
Among them were Bankers Trust Co, Merrill Lynch, BPI Capital, Citibank, Price Waterhouse, Credit Suisse, Solidbank Corp and Ernst and Young.
Basecon is the main government agency in charge of privatising and developing former military camps in the country. -- Manila Newsroom (63 2) 841-8938 Fax 817-6267
